subject: Approval request: Sam Ramirez - Senior ModelOps (EMEA) - one-time incentive + equity refresh
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 03 Aug 2026 09:14:00 +0000
Subject: Approval request: Sam Ramirez - Senior ModelOps (EMEA) - special incentive

Hi Karthik / Ben,

We have an offer on the table for Sam Ramirez (current: Evergrid Labs). Candidate is strong on latency-sensitive model serving, already led a rollout with batching+KV caching improvements — fits the Senior ModelOps profile. Recruiting is requesting an out-of-band one-time cash incentive + small equity refresh to beat a counteroffer. Details below and attached: offer_summary_Sam_Ramirez.pdf and comp_comparison_table.xlsx.

Proposed offer (standard band + exception):
- Base: $185,000 EUR equivalent (within band)
- One-time sign-on (geo & counteroffer): €40,000 cash (requested to close)
- Equity: 0.065% (refresh request; market comp shows 0.08% in competing offer)
- Level: Senior (L5)
- Start date target: 2026-09-20

Rationale:
- Candidate has active counter from competitor with slightly higher cash and similar equity.
- Role is high leverage: expected to reduce token cost via runtime workstreams.
- Hiring manager (Karthik) flags ramp urgency for EMEA infra work.

Ask: approval for one-time cash incentive €40,000 and equity refresh to 0.065% (from standard offer of 0.045%). If we can’t approve cash, would we consider increasing equity to 0.09%?

Attached: offer_summary_Sam_Ramirez.pdf (summary), comp_comparison_table.xlsx (market comps), candidate_resume_sam_ramirez.pdf

Thanks,
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Talent Partner | Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 03 Aug 2026 11:02:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Approval request: Sam Ramirez - Senior ModelOps (EMEA) - special incentive

Thanks Marissa — I read the packet. Sam's background is exactly what we need for the EMEA rollout; the value case on latency/cost reduction is strong. I support a one-time cash incentive to close but want sign-offs on both budget and equity movement.

Can Laura confirm whether we can stretch equity to 0.065% without triggering additional approvals? If not possible, I'd rather approve the cash and keep equity at 0.045% with a 6-month performance refresh clause.

Ben — can you confirm whether there is headcount & budget capacity within ModelOps FY26 hiring for this cash uplift? If not, we should discuss a partial approval and a deferred refresh from the discretionary pool.

Karthik
VP, ModelOps

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 03 Aug 2026 12:45:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Approval request: Sam Ramirez - Senior ModelOps (EMEA) - special incentive

Karthik / Marissa,

Reviewed comp comps. Recommendation below after speaking with Total Rewards:
- Approve one-time cash sign-on: €30,000 (not the full €40k) — we need to cap to preserve equity budget across FY26.
- Equity: increase to 0.06% immediate grant (from 0.045%). Approve an additional performance-based refresh at 6 months conditional on milestones (up to 0.02% additional, funded from discretionary refresh pool).

Conditions:
- Hiring manager to confirm exact milestone language for the 6-month refresh (measurable infra deliverables).
- Offer must include a clawback clause if candidate leaves within 12 months.
- Ben to confirm budget transfer (ModelOps hiring reserve -> sign-on pool).

If Ben confirms budget, I will route a formal exception approval note to People Ops and Legal to amend the offer letter.

Laura
Head of Total Rewards

On attachments: I looked at comp_comparison_table.xlsx — market median supports the combined cash+equity approach given the candidate's critical skill set.

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Sam Ramirez <sam.ramirez@evergrid.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 03 Aug 2026 14:27:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Offer update — next steps and timeline

Hi Sam — quick update from our side. I wanted to let you know we’ve approved a special incentive package and are finalizing the approved numbers. Summary of approved points (pending paperwork):
- One-time sign-on: €30,000 cash (approved)
- Equity: 0.06% immediate grant + eligibility for up to 0.02% performance refresh at 6 months (conditions apply)
- Final offer letter and DocuSign packet will be sent today pending legal language for the 6-month clause and the clawback.

Next steps:
1) Expect DocuSign by end of day with offer_summary_Sam_Ramirez.pdf attached.
2) We’ll ask for signature within 72 hours to hold the package.
3) Start date discussed: target 20 Sep 2026 — we can flex if necessary.

Appreciate your patience — excited to hopefully have you join Redwood.

Best,
Marissa
Senior Talent Partner | Redwood Inference
